items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt or used unit
items.note: Owners report total bills of roughly $1,800 to $3,800. Adding an external transmission cooler afterward is a common upgrade.

items.t: O/D OFF light flashing after highway driving
items.job: Diagnose code and change transmission fluid
items.note: An added external cooler is about $100 to $150 in parts.

items.t: Ignition switch can overheat and smoke (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Airbags can deploy in a minor underbody bump (recall)
items.job: Reprogram airbag sensor unit under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Timing belt tensioner spring can break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace timing belt tensioner under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Brake fluid reservoir cap missing vent holes (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake reservoir cap under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Audio unit short can overheat a speaker (recall)
items.job: Audio unit repair under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Engine may stall while driving (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rough idle or stalling from idle air control valve
items.job: Clean or replace idle air control valve
items.note: Cleaning sometimes fixes it; one owner was quoted about $800 at a shop.

items.t: Vacuum leak causing rough running
items.job: Find and replace leaking vacuum hoses

items.t: Low EGR flow code from clogged passages
items.job: Clean EGR passages and replace intake gaskets
items.note: A new EGR valve adds parts cost if the valve is also bad.

items.t: Check engine light with oxygen sensor codes P1131/P1132
items.job: Diagnose and apply bulletin fix or replace oxygen sensor

items.t: Rough idle and hesitation with check engine light
items.job: Diagnose, apply bulletin repair, replace plugs and wires as needed

items.t: Coolant leak at engine block heater
items.job: Reseal or replace engine block heater

items.t: Water pump leak
items.job: Replace water pump with timing belt and tensioner
items.note: Owners report timing kits around $100; dealer pulleys cost more.

items.t: Coolant reservoir cracks and leaks
items.job: Replace coolant reservoir

items.t: Clutch pedal sinks and will not release
items.job: Replace clutch master or slave cylinder and bleed
items.note: A full clutch job at a dealer is about $800.

items.t: Groaning from front strut mounts in turns
items.job: Replace front strut mounts and struts

items.t: Musty smell from A/C vents
items.job: Clean A/C evaporator and check drain

items.t: Sunroof stuck, binding or noisy
items.job: Service sunroof tracks or replace sunroof motor

items.t: Horn not working or stuck on
items.job: Repair horn switch or replace horn relay

items.t: Shifter can leave Park without pressing the brake
items.job: Inspect and repair brake shift interlock

items.t: Rear drum brake squeal
items.job: Replace rear brake shoes and service drums

items.t: Windshield wipers stop working
items.job: Replace wiper motor or free up linkage
